entities.summary: Ricky Wayne Blanton is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the National Basketball Association's Phoenix Suns in the second round of the 1989 NBA draft. A 6'7" and 215 lb small forward from Louisiana State University (LSU), Blanton signed a 10-day contract and played in only two career NBA games for Chicago Bulls during the 1992–93 season in 18 point wins against the Sacramento Kings on Feb 15, 1993 and Utah Jazz on Feb 17, 1993 at the Chicago Stadium.
